facts.fact: 教堂墓园的墓碑刻着杰西卡在岛上听过的家族姓氏
facts.anchor: The tombstones bore familiar names that Jessica had already heard around the island—Hickoryhollow, Downythistle, Bumblesnatch

facts.fact: 教堂彩窗画的不是耶稣而是野兔，与她见过的谷仓壁画、树上刻痕同款
facts.anchor: Instead, it featured the same stylized hare that she had seen upon Rowan Downythistle’s barn and the Lady Tuppence’s trees

facts.fact: 修会于十六世纪的分裂中与罗马母教会决裂
facts.anchor: They broke from the mother church in Rome during the schisms of the sixteenth century

facts.fact: 牧师把 Round Robin 定性为远古异教神的民俗记忆
facts.anchor: Round Robin is obviously a folk memory of some ancient pagan deity whom they rediscovered

facts.fact: 杰西卡用「上帝是嫉妒的神」质疑此地万神并立
facts.anchor: our God is a jealous god and he specifically said not to put any other gods before him

facts.fact: 牧师讲解玻璃罩里的泥炭头颅：可能死于谋杀、部族争端乃至人祭
facts.anchor: He was probably murdered, possibly in a clan dispute, possibly even as a human sacrifice

facts.fact: 莫莉回忆童年大人用「坏孩子被 Round Robin 带走」吓唬她
facts.anchor: the heads of the bad children who got taken by Round Robin

facts.fact: 结尾 Pip 站在 quagmire 边缘，刷子全新，对两人毫无反应
facts.anchor: His brush was pristine, as if it had never been used
